nodes.label: Allergen not announced in recipe name (fail-open pattern)
nodes.norm_label: allergen not announced in recipe name (fail-open pattern)
nodes.rationale: restriction_tags in the DB are often already correct; the defect is that the recipe's display NAME alone doesn't warn about a real allergen ingredient (milk in a 'vitamina'/'batido', egg via mayonnaise, gluten in 'cuscuz marroquino' which PT-BR readers associate with corn). Someone filtering by name/category without reading the full ingredient sheet can be misled. Same underlying risk class as the confirmed meal_005 case; recommended action is deactivate-until-renamed unless it would zero out a preference×meal_type combination (e.g. meal_114 zeroes pescetarian×dinner entirely).

nodes.label: deterministicPick alphabetical fail-open bug (5th fail-open)
nodes.rationale: When the safe exercise pool has no candidate matching the slot's target muscle group, deterministicPick silently filled with the alphabetically-first exercise from the whole pool (always a squat, ex_001/003/006) and flagged degraded:true only in the ephemeral HTTP response, never persisted. Fixed 2026-09-04 by skipping the slot instead (Estágio 2), persisting training_plans.skipped_slots, and surfacing staff/student messages via buildPlanPayload.ts — chosen over a broad-category fallback (Estágio 1) because no real muscle hierarchy exists in schema and reusing MUSCLE_CATEGORY_MAP would repeat the same problem at smaller scale (forearms and chest share the 'superior' bucket).

nodes.label: MUSCLE_CATEGORY_MAP — 4-bucket day-label heuristic, not a muscle hierarchy
nodes.norm_label: muscle_category_map — 4-bucket day-label heuristic, not a muscle hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded 4-bucket map (superior/inferior/core/cardio) in _shared/buildPlanPayload.ts:61-73 exists only to compute the display label for a training day via majority vote; it is incomplete (hip_flexors/adductors/abductors unmapped) and clinically unsafe if reused for exercise-substitution decisions — forearms and chest both fall in 'superior'. A real muscle hierarchy needs personal-trainer curation, not a 4-line map.

nodes.label: Systematic ingredient-substitution offset bug (99 meals)
nodes.rationale: 99/99 mismatched meals show 'ingredient wrong', never 'stale text' — name+preparation always tell a coherent story that the ingredient list contradicts. ~85/99 fall into ~10 consistent A→B substitution patterns (e.g. cenoura→polenta, 12 cases, 100% consistent), evidence the bug is in an ingredient-assignment step fed by a shifted/wrong source, not in name/text generation. Three cases form multi-link chains (macarrão→quinoa→cuscuz de milho; banana-da-terra→maçã→laranja; arroz↔batata doce swapped in both directions) requiring per-meal correction rather than a generic find-and-replace.

nodes.label: Nutritionist-must-approve gate before bulk catalog fixes
nodes.norm_label: nutritionist-must-approve gate before bulk catalog fixes
nodes.rationale: Even though the ingredient-swap patterns are mechanically consistent and reversible, no correction is applied without the nutritionist approving each mapping row-by-row first — reflecting the standing rule that nutrition catalog content is AI-built and needs a mandatory professional review gate before being trusted (ver memória project_nutrition_needs_professional_review_gate).
